body.name: rStar
body.def: When \(U_\delta(b,q,\omega)<1\), let \(r_\star(\delta)=\min\{\lVert\omega'-\omega\rVert_1:\omega'\in\Delta(\mathcal V),\ x\in\mathcal P_\delta(b,q,\omega),\ \rho_{11}(x,\omega')\geq\rho_{21}(x,\omega')\}\). When \(L_\delta(b,q,\omega)>1\), reverse the displayed inequality. The minimum of the empty set is \(+\infty\); if neither strict baseline frontier holds, set \(r_\star(\delta)=0\).
body.role: common-law mixture radius at which the strict baseline ratio sign first ceases to be uniform, pointwise in the priming sensitivity value
